items.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009
items.q: Yes, a lot of professional musicians like Max Roach or the Prez, you know a lot of musicians like that I’ve played with

ctx.x: Henry, was there somebody in your past that you really felt that set you on — or helped you on your musical career and your path that you were trying to take?

Yes, a lot of professional musicians like Max Roach or the Prez, you know a lot of musicians like that I’ve played with and you know I’d have to go through my struggle up there, which they encouraged me about that.

I always felt like the bass player had a lot of responsibility. Because first, I mean if you don’t know the tune, who’s going to hear it? A saxophone player can sort of negotiate things by listening to the bass player. But who’s the bass player listening to?
